item: Source manager tests use a database of their own, never the live store (row 261, the order-dependent country form failure)
summary: The db_session fixture bound to the app's live engine and ran drop_all at every teardown, dropping app_state from the suite's store; the kv store had seen that path, so a later country form read raised StoreFormUnreadable and held the failure for 2 s, failing 9 tests in test_source_metadata_reconcile and test_source_standing_r773 in the same worker. The fixture now uses its own SQLite file under tmp_path; a guard test fails against the old fixture. Reproduced: 9 failed before, 74 passed after. Test-only, no release line.
